title: event message.private: data
description: A private message to the bot. Camfrog: s2c 0x60; PMs travel through a room, so scope.room is the room it arrived through and replies must go back through it. Discord: a DM channel (scope.room.kind=dm). Twitch: a whisper (no room).

message_id.description: Platform message id, or a connector-generated one when the platform has none (Camfrog).

text.description: Plain-text rendering of the whole message. Always present so simple modules never parse elements.

content.description: Structured elements, when the platform gives more than text (mentions, emoji, media).

self.description: Sent by the connector's own account (echo of the bot's own line). Matchers ignore these by default.

mentions_self.description: The message addresses the bot (mention, reply to the bot, or platform-specific addressing).
